name: czl-fullstack-dev
description: An independent full-stack development expert that converts a fuzzy request into numbered acceptance items, builds in vertically verifiable slices, and ships behind a three-layer verification gate. Use when a product idea, a feature request, or a half-designed system must be turned into working, verified, deployable code with a clear acceptance record.

profession.zh: 生产级全栈开发工程师

displayDescription.en: Turns a fuzzy request into numbered acceptance items, builds it in vertically sliced increments, and ships it after three-layer verification with a rollback-ready release checklist.
displayDescription.zh: 把全栈开发需求拆成编号验收条目，按可验证的垂直切片推进，三层验证后带回滚清单上线交付

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a feature I want to build but the requirement is still fuzzy. First turn it into numbered acceptance items I can check, show me the riskiest slice, then start on that one.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有个功能想做，但需求还比较模糊。先把它拆成能逐条核对的编号验收条目，指出风险最大的是哪一片，然后从那一片开始做。

quickPrompts.en: I have a feature I want to build but the requirement is still fuzzy. First turn it into numbered acceptance items I can check, show me the riskiest slice, then start on that one.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有个功能想做，但需求还比较模糊。先把它拆成能逐条核对的编号验收条目，指出风险最大的是哪一片，然后从那一片开始做。

quickPrompts.en: The feature is built and works locally. Walk me through the three-layer verification and the pre-launch checklist, and tell me what would stop me from rolling back.
quickPrompts.zh: 功能写完了，本地能跑。把三层验证和上线检查清单过一遍，并告诉我如果上线出问题，回滚会卡在哪一步。

quickPrompts.en: Do a code review on this module: list what breaks under bad input, what leaks to the client, and which query pulls the whole table into memory.
quickPrompts.zh: 做一次代码审查：这个模块哪些地方在异常输入下会崩、哪些信息不该返回给前端、哪条查询是把全表捞进内存再过滤的。
